verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document GlitchTip connecting to source repositories, showing suspect commits or code owners on an issue, or linking stack frames to lines on a default branch. Adjacent features do not count: source-map uploads, CLI release and deploy records, team-based notifications, and GitLab's ability to display GlitchTip errors (which runs in the opposite direction). The generic Sentry-API-compatibility claim does not evidence this specific capability.
